acceptanceCriteria: 404 POST /api/v2/widgets/42/archive with only POST /api/widgets/:id/archive is flagged naming the existing route.
A 404 on a matched path is accepted unchanged.
An unresolvable path is reported uncertain with a reason.
body: When a blocked/fixture-gap classification or run failure note cites a 404 and a request path, resolve method+path against the route table: no match -> BLOCKER-404-NO-ROUTE naming nearest routes; route without action -> reuse ROUTE-ACTION-MISSING; match -> accept unchanged; unresolvable (dynamic/mounted) -> uncertain with reason.
title: GH #1215: blocker classification cross-checks a cited HTTP 404 path against the route table (BLOCKER-404-NO-ROUTE)
